BC_description: The 'execPath' option has been renamed to 'nodePath', and it now only functions when the 'node' option is set to true. This change may break existing code that uses 'execPath' without the 'node' option.
Adaptation_method: Change the 'execPath' option to 'nodePath' and ensure the 'node' option is set to true if needed. Example: await execa('node', ['file.js'], { nodePath: './path/to/node', node: true }); // Instead of { execPath: './path/to/node' }
